card.name: Cross-reference punctuation after section numbers
card.fires_on: Closing parenthesis or comma right after a section number inside a bracketed cross-reference like [see Warnings and Precautions (5.12), ...]. Also the word 'regarding' in a '(see ... regarding' pointer.

modes.label: After section number
modes.description: A ')' or ',' following a numbered section reference inside a [see ...] pointer.
modes.example: [see Warnings and Precautions ( 5.12<< ),>> Use in Specific Populations ( 8

modes.label: See-pointer wording
modes.description: The word 'regarding' or 'Precautions' inside a 'see' pointer to another part of the label.
modes.example: (see next paragraph<< regarding>> flushing of tubing)

card.writes: Seems to push toward the next item in a list of label section cross-references, and away from words like 'below' or 'topics'.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a label where a cross-reference to another section is being written, right after a section number.
